title: Structured Interviews
basis: Structured interviews gather evidence about job-related competencies through systematic questions.

title: Employee induction
locator: Public introduction before the membership boundary; guide dated 4 April 2025
basis: Induction includes information about the organization, team, role, responsibilities and ways of working.

title: Recording absence
locator: How to record sickness absence; Avoiding discrimination; Data protection
basis: Absence records require careful recording and relevant, confidential sharing; different contexts must not be collapsed indiscriminately.
limits: Our half-day arithmetic and approval rules are fictional. No statutory leave, medical eligibility or discriminatory trigger scoring is modeled.

title: Collecting and keeping employment records
locator: Data minimisation, accuracy, retention and the page’s guidance-under-review notice
basis: Records should be limited to the stated purpose, kept accurate, and reviewed for retention.
limits: The page is under review following legislation. No current legal deadline, lawful-basis conclusion or universal consent rule is imported into fixtures.

title: Practical Advice for Drafting and Implementing Reasonable Accommodation Procedures Under Executive Order 13164
locator: Initiating the accommodation process: purpose and limits of request-confirmation forms
basis: Request tracking should be distinguished from deciding an accommodation and unnecessarily gathering medical documentation.
limits: Historical federal guidance is motivation for a narrow fictional referral. No eligibility, legal compliance, employer obligation or medical judgment is scored.

locator: Public factsheet overview and pay-band discussion
basis: Pay structures use grades or ranges associated with job families and organizational needs.
limits: No market salaries, private pay data, member-only tools or approved remuneration decisions were taken. All amounts/thresholds are fictional.

title: Investigations at work: carrying out an investigation
locator: Opening evidence/objectivity/confidentiality guidance and Getting physical evidence
basis: An investigation gathers reasonable evidence objectively and confidentially rather than trying to prove guilt.
limits: Our task prepares a checklist only. It does not investigate real people, determine guilt, recommend sanctions or make an employment decision.
